## release: promote develop to main

Operator-authorized launch promotion, **pinned to `791b59e7af`** (current develop tip). Supersedes #18316 (pinned `b47acfdb9e`), whose SHA deterministically failed cert on a stale test — that SHA had captured develop in the gap between #18315 (list_agents reads became planner-only) and `87112c2bcb` (the test alignment). This pin includes the aligned test, plus #18323 (image cold-cache 503 retry) and the develop lint repair.

All prior certification analysis carries: the Fable-5 go/no-go (GO_WITH_CONDITIONS), release-risk audit (one idempotent auto-applied migration, no new secrets, additive routes, clean revert-merge rollback), and the 8-step post-merge launch chain in HQ #18309.

**Gate:** merge only when this PR's CI (pull_request run on the pinned SHA) concludes with Required = SUCCESS; vps-agent posts the green signal; shipwright executes the single merge; watchtower runs prod-verify + the deploy chain.
